verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI features include generating PR titles and descriptions (docs-54), and Graphite Chat can summarize or explain a PR's changes on request (docs-6, docs-21, docs-29). There is no evidence that every PR automatically gets a summary or a structured change walkthrough: the automatic per-PR behavior documented is AI review that flags issues (docs-4, docs-19), not orientation summaries. Missing for 10: documented automatic summary generation on every PR, a structured file-by-file change walkthrough, in-depth docs on the description-generation feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
